sloka: यथा च मन्ये दुर्जीवम् एवम् न सुकरम् ध्रुवम् ।आच्चिद्य पुत्रे निर्याते कौसल्या यत्र जीवति ॥२-५७-२२॥
transliteration: yathā ca manye durjīvam evam na sukaram dhruvam ।āccidya putre niryāte kausalyā yatra jīvati ॥2-57-22॥

translations.english: I think it is indeed difficult for Kausalya to live wherever and whichever way she tries as she has been separated from her son. (the queens said).
